'''Luhin Jinnor''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warrant Officer/Legends|Warrant Officer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was stationed on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] on orders of [[Booto Lubble]], a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] liason for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
